descricao: This level is surrounded by a dark abyss which should be avoided. It is a massive parking garage with typical warm lights, as well as colored green and blue lights which shine somewhat dimly. This complex has six floors, including a roof. Strangely enough, this level is not infinite, and there are walls along the perimeter the size of a typical car park. Rarely, a car can be spotted. Entering these vehicles results in varying effects. Exits are common on this level, however, they should be avoided at all costs. Upon approaching one, the complex fills with cars.
